description: Header file declaring functions and macros for RSA exponentiation optimized with AVX2 instructions, specifically for 1024-bit integers in the BoringSSL/OpenSSL cryptography library.

methods.name: RSAZ_1024_mod_exp_avx2
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation of a 1024-bit base raised to an exponent using AVX2 instructions.

methods.name: rsaz_avx2_capable
methods.description: Checks if AVX2 is supported on the current CPU.

methods.name: rsaz_avx2_preferred
methods.description: Determines if AVX2-based methods are preferred based on CPU capabilities.

methods.name: rsaz_1024_norm2red_avx2
methods.description: Converts a normalized BIGNUM to RSAZ representation.

methods.name: rsaz_1024_mul_avx2
methods.description: Multiplies two RSAZ-formatted 1024-bit integers modulo n.

methods.name: rsaz_1024_sqr_avx2
methods.description: Squares a RSAZ-formatted 1024-bit integer modulo n, repeated count times.

methods.name: rsaz_1024_scatter5_avx2
methods.description: Stores a value at a specific index in a packed table.

methods.name: rsaz_1024_gather5_avx2
methods.description: Loads a value from a specific index in a packed table.

methods.name: rsaz_1024_red2norm_avx2
methods.description: Converts RSAZ representation back to BIGNUM format.
